comments.content: PopupWindow is shown from a WindowManager overlay anchor with no attachment/token check and no error handling. If the overlay is concurrently hidden or its window token is invalidated (e.g. teardown racing with the long-press, multi-window transition), showAsDropDown throws WindowManager.BadTokenException and crashes the process. Guard with anchor.isAttachedToWindow and wrap the show call in try/catch; consider a setOnDismissListener if any caller-side cleanup is added later.

comments.content: Vertical placement has no fallback when neither side fits: if roomBelow < popupH and anchorLoc[1] < popupH (anchor near top), yoff stays 0 and the menu bottom is clipped off-screen. Also screenH comes from displayMetrics.heightPixels, which ignores status/nav bar insets and cutouts, so "fits below" can be misjudged at screen edges. Clamp the popup's absolute top edge into [0, screenH - popupH] as a defensive fallback (horizontal already does this via coerceIn).

comments.content: The voice indicator is built from a snapshot (voiceEnabled) and afterwards updated solely from onToggleVoice()'s return value. If the underlying toggle doesn't actually change state (or changes elsewhere while the popup stays open), the dot shows a stale/wrong state and the open popup offers no refresh path. Make the failure/explicit-state contract explicit (e.g. callback returns the authoritative new state or a Result<Boolean>) and derive the dot from it; the current "return new state" contract is also implicit for future callers.
